subject: Help understand cellularity on sorted leukemia cells

messages.author: a3ecf093d626b92f
messages.subject: Help understand cellularity on sorted leukemia cells
parts: I am running sequenza on whole exome data of sorted liquid tumor cells. Some samples have lower cellularity values than the others. The observation seems to be a paradox, as cellularity is the fraction of tumor cells inside tumor sample and does not seem to make sense for pure sorted tumor cells for our case. I really appreciate if anyone could help understand this interesting observation. Thank you so much!
